channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Após encontro entre Lula e Trump, EUA e Brasil têm reunião sobre tarifas
item.description: The U.S. and Brazil held a first meeting on tariffs following the May 7 meeting between Presidents Lula and Trump. U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said he met with Minister Márcio Elias Rosa of the Mdic on Tuesday, May 19.

item.title: Brasil e EUA têm 1ª reunião sobre tarifas 12 dias após encontro Lula-Trump
item.description: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer announced the first meeting with Brazilian Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services Márcio Fernando Elias Rosa to discuss a trade agreement that would avoid new U.S. tariffs on Brazil. The meeting took place 12 days after the Lula-Trump encounter.

item.title: Até onde a elite vai com os Bolsonaro?
item.description: Part of Brazil's economic and political elite shows leniency toward instabilities caused by the Bolsonaro family, particularly by waiting to see if Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy remains viable despite daily evidence of his ties to Daniel Vorcaro. This reflects a pattern of exceptional tolerance not seen with other political groups, even amid recurring scandals. The article frames this as a renewed, though not new, phenomenon in the relationship between established power and the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: O encontro de Flávio Bolsonaro com Daniel Vorcaro e o futuro da delação do banqueiro - O Assunto #1723
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro admitted meeting with Daniel Vorcaro after the banker's arrest to 'put an end' to the financing of the film 'Dark Horse'. Vorcaro funded over 90% of the budget for the Jair Bolsonaro biopic, and messages with allies like Mário Frias show gratitude for the support. Vorcaro's transfer to a common cell signals the likely failure of his plea bargain, as authorities found no relevant information in the eight seized phones.

item.title: Datafolha: eleitor vê Lula como o mais experiente e Flávio como o mais inovador
item.description: Lula is seen as the most experienced pre-candidate (55%), while Flávio Bolsonaro is considered the most modern and innovative (31%), according to a Datafolha poll. Among unaffiliated voters, Lula leads in experience (52%) and Flávio in innovation (22%). The survey was conducted on May 12–13 with 2,004 voters aged 16 or older.

item.title: De não haver um 'único centavo' de Vorcaro ao 'Deus te abençoe meu brother': veja as contradições de Mário Frias sobre o filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: Mario Frias, an ally of Bolsonaro, thanked banker Daniel Vorcaro for supporting the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, in December 2024 messages, despite previously claiming he received 'not a single cent' from Vorcaro. The conversations reveal Frias viewed the project as a 'divine justice' and a 'great miracle' for 2026, while Vorcaro allegedly transferred around R$ 61 million to the film before his arrest.

item.title: Juro da linha de crédito para taxistas e motoristas de aplicativo será diferente para homem e mulher. Veja as taxas e outras condições
item.description: President Lula signed a provisional measure launching the 'Move Brasil' program, providing special credit for taxi and app-based drivers to purchase vehicles, with gender-differentiated interest rates: 12.6% per year for men and 11.5% per year for women, both below the current Selic rate of 14.5%. The government will release R$30 billion through BNDES, offering more favorable terms for women to reduce financing costs compared to current vehicle rentals.

item.title: Prestação de contas, lucro de Vorcaro e explicações a aliados: a estratégia de Flávio para tentar reduzir desgaste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is attempting to mitigate political damage from revelations about his ties to Daniel Vorcaro by pledging financial transparency for the film 'Dark Horse' and isolating Vorcaro’s investment for potential return to authorities. During a meeting with PL allies, he reiterated that his relationship with Vorcaro was limited to film financing, despite having visited him at home in late 2025 after his arrest. Nevertheless, distrust persists within the party due to fears of further disclosures, particularly following reports by Intercept Brasil.

item.title: Entre almoço na Faria Lima e jantar empresarial, Flávio tenta conter desgaste de revelações sobre relação com Vorcaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is holding meetings in São Paulo to mitigate political fallout after admitting he met in person with banker Daniel Vorcaro, who was under house arrest, to discuss closing an audiovisual project tied to former President Jair Bolsonaro. The engagements with financial executives and tourism business leaders are taking place in a cautious atmosphere, with fears of partial attendance due to leak concerns, though his team is pushing to expand public appearances to avoid perceptions of political retreat.

item.title: Presidente do DC, de Joaquim Babosa, foi condenado na máfia dos sanguessugas
item.description: Aldo Rebelo's presidential candidacy was discontinued after failing to gain traction in polls, with less than 1% voter intention. João Caldas, president of the Christian Democracy party, justified the decision with a football analogy, stating that keeping a candidate with no chances is like leaving an injured player on the field when a high-quality substitute like Neymar is on the bench. The subscriber-only article highlights the end of Rebelo's electoral attempt, a former communist, within the party.

item.title: PT lança pré-candidaturas de Grass ao governo do DF e Kokay ao Senado
item.description: The PT officially launched the pre-candidacies of Leandro Grass for Governor of the Federal District and Erika Kokay for the Senate at an event of the Brazil of Hope Federation. Both candidates criticized the current DF government, accusing it of weakening social indicators, aligning with business interests, and engaging in 'plundering public finances,' while advocating for a government aligned with Lula and victory in the first round.

item.title: Após encontro Lula-Trump, EUA e Brasil têm 1ª reunião sobre tarifaço
item.description: Following the May 7 meeting between Presidents Lula and Trump at the White House, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer held a virtual meeting with Brazil’s Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services, Márcio Fernando Elias Rosa, to continue negotiations on the U.S.-imposed 'tariff shock'. The discussion focused on advancing a bilateral working group tasked with delivering a concrete proposal within 30 days to resolve trade disputes and reduce barriers.

item.title: Cruzeiro empata com Boca Juniors na Bombonera e assume liderança
item.description: Cruzeiro drew 1-1 with Boca Juniors at La Bombonera in the 5th round of the Libertadores, taking first place in Group D with 8 points. Merentiel scored for Boca in the first half, and Fagner equalized for Cruzeiro in the second half following a play by Kaiki, confirmed by VAR. Cruzeiro will face Chapecoense on Sunday in the Brasileirão.

item.title: Não há “explicação convincente”, diz Zema sobre Flávio e Vorcaro
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo), a pre-candidate for president, stated there is no "convincing explanation" for the relationship between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, after Flávio confirmed meeting Vorcaro following his first arrest in December 2025 to demand R$134 million pledged for the film "Dark Horse". Zema called the episode "regrettable" and emphasized credibility as essential for governance, reiterating prior criticism of leaked audio showing Flávio requesting money from Vorcaro.

item.title: Após encontro entre Trump e Lula, representantes de Brasil e EUA se reúnem para dar sequência à agenda comercial
item.description: Following the May 7, 2026 meeting between Donald Trump and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at the White House, U.S. and Brazilian trade officials held a virtual meeting to advance the bilateral agenda. Brazilian Minister of Development, Industry, Commerce and Services Márcio Fernando Elias Rosa and the U.S. Trade Representative discussed revitalizing economic and commercial ties, emphasizing strategic partnership in trade, investment, and international cooperation. Both sides highlighted constructive engagement and expressed expectation for continued talks.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que blinda orçamento de partidos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved, by symbolic vote, Bill 4822/2025, which weakens financial sanctions against political parties by capping fines for rejected accounts at R$30,000, blocking seizure of Partisan and Electoral Fund resources, and allowing debt repayment over up to 15 years. The law also prohibits fund suspensions during election semesters and prevents local party sanctions from automatically affecting national leadership. Critics, including Kim Kataguiri, Adriana Ventura, Chico Alencar, and Fernanda Melchionna, condemned the lack of a recorded vote as cowardly.

item.title: Diagnosticado com linfoma, José Dirceu recebe alta após 9 dias
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT) was discharged from São Paulo’s Sírio-Libanês Hospital after a 9-day stay for lymphoma treatment, diagnosed on May 10. He reaffirmed his intention to run for federal deputy in the 2026 elections and expressed continued support for Lula, Haddad, and other PT allies, stating he will keep fighting for Lula’s re-election and progress in São Paulo.

item.title: "Tem que perguntar para o Flávio", diz Michelle sobre áudios a Vorcaro. Veja vídeo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro declined to comment on the audio messages between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro, stating that Flávio should address the matter himself. She emphasized her focus on supporting her husband, Jair Bolsonaro, and her work with PL Mulher, denying any personal ambition for presidential or senatorial office.

item.title: Novo foi traído ao não ter sido avisado sobre Flávio e Vorcaro, diz Zema
item.description: Romeu Zema, pre-candidate for presidency from the Novo party, claimed the party was 'betrayed' for not being informed about the meeting between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and businessman Daniel Vorcaro, who allegedly financed the film 'Dark Horse' with R$ 61 million. Zema stated that no one in Novo was notified of the contact and that he believed such interaction did not exist until public confirmation. The remarks follow Flávio's admission of the meeting and mutual criticisms between the two regarding the timing of the accusations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro contradiz discursos anteriores ao confirmar visita a Daniel Vorcaro; relembre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed he met with Daniel Vorcaro after the former banker’s first arrest in November 2025, stating the purpose of the meeting was to put a 'final point' on the financing of the film about his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The PL-RJ presidential pre-candidate had previously denied or downplayed any ties to Vorcaro, making this confirmation a direct contradiction of his earlier statements.

item.title: Argumentos de Flávio para pedir suspensão de pesquisa no TSE são frágeis, dizem especialistas
item.description: Experts consulted by Folha consider the arguments from Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign to suspend the Atlas/Bloomberg poll at the TSE as weak. The request was made by his team, but experts say there are no solid legal grounds for such a measure. The incident occurred on May 19, 2026.

item.title: Datafolha: Lula é visto como mais experiente, e Flávio, como mais inovador
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows Brazilian voters perceive President Lula as the most experienced pre-candidate for the 2026 elections, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is seen as the most modern and innovative. The survey evaluates the image of pre-candidates for the presidency, highlighting contrasting perceptions between the two leading figures.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que dá 15 anos para partido pagar multa e libera disparos de mensagens
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill limiting electoral fines for disapproved accounts to 30,000 reais, establishing a 15-year payment deadline for party debts and allowing automated electoral message dispatches. The text also blocks the seizure of party fund resources for debts, even in labor or criminal cases, except when misuse is proven by the Electoral Justice.

item.title: Minirreforma eleitoral permite programa de recuperação fiscal para partidos políticos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputados approved the electoral mini-reform allowing the use of the Fiscal Recovery Program (Refis) for political parties' debts, with installment periods up to 180 months, replicating rules from Constitutional Amendment 133/24. The bill also permits approval of party accounts with reservations if flaws do not exceed 10% of annual revenues, excluding estimable revenues without bad faith, and grants the Electoral Justice one year to identify inconsistencies — after which the opinion becomes favorable if no response is made. It further bans subjective value judgments on party expenditures and sets rules to prevent the seating of substitutes who changed parties, except within federations.

item.title: Presidente do TSE destaca atuação da Justiça Eleitoral no combate à fraude à cota de gênero
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques highlighted the supplementary elections held in Melgaço (PA) after nearly 80% of valid votes from the 2024 Elections were annulled due to gender quota fraud. The vote renewed all 11 seats in the Municipal Chamber, resulting in the election of three women — the first time in 35 years that women were elected as councilors in the municipality. Nunes Marques praised the speed of vote counting — completed by 6 p.m. with 100% of ballots processed — and emphasized the democratic significance of the outcome as a mature public response to gender inclusion in politics.

item.title: Cabo Gilberto diz que “PT está envolvido em todos os roubos do Brasil” ao defender Flávio
item.description: Federal Deputy Cabo Gilberto Silva (PL-PB) claimed the PT is involved in 'all the robberies in Brazil' while defending Senator Fl�vio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) during a speech in the Chamber of Deputies. The statement followed the controversy over audio recordings involving the pre-candidate. He used the floor to attack the Lula government and reinforce the opposition's stance.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sugere alternativa ao fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposed flexibilizing the CLT to allow hourly wage payment, preserving proportional labor rights, as an alternative to ending the 6×1 work schedule. He criticized the government's proposal to reduce the workweek to 40 hours with two paid rest days, arguing it would cause mass unemployment and higher living costs. The government's bill has union support but faces employer opposition and expert division.

item.title: Câmara aprova PL que limita punições da Justiça Eleitoral a partidos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill limiting electoral justice penalties to political parties, preventing national directories from being financially liable for infractions by state or municipal levels. The measure also extends installment plans for electoral fines and treasury repayments to up to 180 months and now proceeds to Senate review.

item.title: Neymar sobre convocação para a Copa: "Chorei por várias horas"
item.description: Neymar cried for several hours after being called up by Carlo Ancelotti for the 2026 World Cup with the Brazilian national team. He thanked Santos FC for their support and shared the emotional moment in a YouTube video from the club. Brazil is in Group C of the World Cup, set to face Morocco in their opener on June 13, with preparatory matches against Panama and Egypt.

item.title: Alcolumbre marca sessão no Congresso para analisar veto de Lula que barra repasses a municípios inadimplentes
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has scheduled a congressional session for Thursday (21) to review and attempt to overturn President Lula’s vetoes on the 2026 Budget Guidelines Law (LDO), which barred municipalities with up to 65,000 inhabitants and fiscal noncompliance from signing federal funding agreements. Alcolumbre stated that overturning the veto would benefit over 3,000 municipalities by restoring access to federal resources. The executive branch justified the vetoes on grounds of unconstitutionality, contradiction to public interest, violation of the Fiscal Responsibility Law, and encroachment on matters reserved for complementary legislation.

item.title: A tentativa do STF de notificar Mário Frias por causa do filme sobre Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) failed to notify Deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) regarding an investigation into the alleged misappropriation of R$ 2 million in parliamentary amendments to an NGO linked to the producer of a Bolsonaro biopic, as he no longer resides at the address provided by the Chamber of Deputados and is reportedly on an international mission. Justice Minister Flávio Dino had ordered the notification, but bailiffs were unable to locate him in March and April. Frias denies wrongdoing, citing a favorable opinion from the Chamber’s Legal Advisory.

item.title: MP que reajusta salário de professores é aprovada por comissão do Congresso
item.description: The mixed congressional committee approved a provisional measure raising the national minimum salary for basic education teachers by 5.4% in 2026, increasing the floor from R$4,867.77 to R$5,130.63. The reform extends the benefit to temporary teachers and revises the adjustment formula to combine the prior year's INPC with 50% of the average real revenue variation of Fundeb over the past five years, ensuring a real gain of 1.5 percentage points above 2025's inflation.

item.title: Zema e Renan Santos dizem que explicações de Flávio sobre encontro com Vorcaro não são convincentes
item.description: Romeu Zema and Renan Santos criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for failing to provide convincing explanations about his meeting with former banker Daniel Vorcaro, stating the visit lacks credibility and questioning his fitness as a pre-candidate. Ronaldo Caiado said Flávio must account to society but avoided direct criticism, taking a more cautious stance.

item.title: TSE aprova resolução que regulamenta a criação de cargos na Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The TSE unanimously approved a resolution regulating the creation of permanent, commissioned, and appointed positions within the Electoral Justice system, in accordance with Law No. 15.374/2026. The norm sets technical, budgetary, and administrative criteria for implementing new personnel structures, prioritizing minimum staffing levels in electoral zones and requiring approval by TRE plenaries. President Nunes Marques emphasized that the measure strengthens the Electoral Justice’s operational capacity amid rising technological and administrative demands.

item.title: Caiado: “Quem tem autoridade moral para sentar na cadeira?”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) argued at a São Paulo supermarket sector event that the next Brazilian president must possess 'moral authority' to govern. He stated that while he believes the opposition can defeat Lula in 2026, the decisive factor is not just winning the election, but who will have the ethical legitimacy to occupy the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que fragiliza julgamento de contas partidárias e permite disparos de mensagem em massa
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill weakening the oversight of party accounts, limiting fines, banning sanctions during the election semester, and allowing mass messaging by parties and politicians. Introduced abruptly by House Speaker Hugo Motta, the measure takes effect immediately, challenging the electoral law’s annuality principle, and now moves to the Senate for review.

item.title: Zema chama relação de Flávio Bolsonaro com Vorcaro de traição: 'Ninguém do Novo foi avisado'
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized the meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniel Vorcaro as a betrayal of the New Party, stating that no party member was informed of the contact. Zema questioned the legitimacy of the meeting, reaffirming his anti-corruption stance and denying any personal relationship with the banker. Flávio Bolsonaro defended the meeting as an effort to conclude the funding of the film 'Dark Horse', linked to Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: MENTIU DE NOVO: Flávio foi à casa de Daniel Vorcaro após prisão do ex-banqueiro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro admitted visiting the home of Daniel Vorcaro, an investigated former banker, after Vorcaro's arrest by the Federal Police in late 2025. The meeting raised suspicions, as Flávio is a presidential pre-candidate who met with someone wearing an electronic ankle monitor. The case raises concerns about potential illegal influence or agreements amid ongoing investigations.

item.title: Câmara aprova projeto que impede bloqueio de bens de partidos e abre brecha para disparos em massa
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved a bill that renegotiates party debts for up to 15 years, sets a cap on fines for rejected party accounts, and allows mass messaging via robots, raising concerns about transparency and electoral influence.

item.title: José Dirceu recebe alta do hospital após ser internado com linfoma
item.description: Former minister José Dirceu (PT-SP) was discharged from the Sírio-Libanês Hospital after being hospitalized for duodenal lymphoma, having completed his first cycle of chemotherapy without complications. Despite his diagnosis, he stated he intends to maintain his pre-campaign for federal deputy in São Paulo, adapting his strategy to virtual activities and livestreams, and expressed confidence in overcoming the disease and reelecting Lula. His allies, including his son Zeca Dirceu, affirmed his commitment to the campaign and ongoing treatment.

item.title: Flávio desistiu de vencer Lula ao não abrir todo jogo sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lost the trust of right-wing allies by concealing his contacts with banker Daniel Vorcaro, undermining his credibility as a potential 2026 presidential candidate. Though he has not formally withdrawn, his allies say he has abandoned the goal of defeating Lula, instead prioritizing family control over the conservative movement over winning the election. The gradual exposure of his relationship with Vorcaro has created uncertainty and disappointed supporters who expected a clear, transparent leadership.

item.title: Odair Cunha se despede da Câmara para assumir vaga no TCU
item.description: Federal deputy Odair Cunha (PT-MG) delivered his final speech in the Chamber of Deputies on Tuesday (19/5) before taking office as a minister of the Tribunal of Accounts of the Union (TCU) on Wednesday (20/5). He was elected with 303 favorable votes in the Chamber and 50 in the Senate, filling one of the three parliamentary-indicated seats. At 41, he holds a law degree and has a political trajectory in Minas Gerais, including state presidency of the Workers' Party and a role in the State Government Secretariat (Segov).

item.title: Câmara aprova texto-base de projeto que limita punições da Justiça Eleitoral a partidos
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the base text of a bill that changes the rules for holding political parties accountable for fines and sanctions imposed by the Electoral Justice. The text establishes individualized penalties across national, state, and municipal party levels and prevents automatic deductions from the Party Fund quotas. The proposal aims to limit collective liability, ensuring only the directly responsible party bodies are sanctioned.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes anula condenação de deputado Zeca Dirceu por postagem em que afirmava que Deltan Dallagnol está inelegível
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Gilmar Mendes overturned a ruling by the Paraná Regional Electoral Court that had ordered federal deputy Zeca Dirceu to delete social media posts stating that Deltan Dallagnol is ineligible and calling him a 'criminal'. The decision held that the posts were based on public and notorious facts, including the TSE’s explicit recognition of Dallagnol’s eight-year ineligibility due to fraud under the Clean Record Law, and that the electoral court’s order constituted unconstitutional prior censorship.

item.title: SEM INDUÇÃO: Analista da AtlasIntel desmente ataques e explica rigor em pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: Yuri Sanches, head of political analysis at AtlasIntel, denied allegations of bias in electoral polls, stating that the audio from the Flávio Bolsonaro scandal was only presented after the electoral questionnaire was completed, in a separate phase, ensuring data integrity. He emphasized the methodological rigor of the survey, which, according to him, accurately reflects the real impact of the scandal involving the politician. The goal was to counter attempts to discredit the decline in Flávio Bolsonaro's voting intentions.

item.title: Justiça determina penhora de bens de Zambelli após condenação por uso irregular de foto de Boulos
item.description: São Paulo's Justice ordered the seizure of assets from former congresswoman Carla Zambelli (PL-SP) to pay a R$17,000 indemnity for unauthorized use of a photo of Guilherme Boulos. The order was issued this Monday, while Zambelli remains detained in Italy awaiting extradition to Brazil, where she faces STF convictions for invading CNJ systems and had her mandate annulled.

item.title: Flávio diz ao PL que revelações acabaram e explica silêncio sobre Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) told allies there is no new information regarding his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, stating that everything has already been made public and explaining his silence with the phrase 'who would speak?!'. He confirmed meeting Vorcaro after the latter's arrest and discussed payments for the film 'Dark Horse', according to Intercept Brasil. The case has divided the PL: the ideological wing sees it as temporary, while the pragmatic faction fears electoral damage to congressional candidacies.

item.title: STF não consegue notificar Mário Frias sobre filme de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) failed to notify federal deputy Mário Frias (PL-SP) regarding alleged misappropriation of R$2 million in parliamentary amendments to an NGO linked to the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', which portrays the political trajectory of Jair Bolsonaro. Frias was not found at his official Brasília address, provided by the Chamber of Deputies, as he has not resided there for two years. Minister Flávio Dino ordered the notification following a representation by deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP).

item.title: Caiado cita 'autoridade moral' e cobra que Flávio Bolsonaro 'preste contas à população' após relato de encontro com Vorcaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado argued that the 2026 presidential race should center on 'moral authority' and urged Flávio Bolsonaro to account to the public for his meeting with banker Andre Vorcaro following the latter’s release from prison. While avoiding direct criticism, Caiado emphasized personal accountability and highlighted his own 40-year public record free of scandal. The remarks were made at an Apas event, standing in contrast to Romeu Zema’s harsher stance, which labeled the meeting 'unforgivable'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro exibe dados de favoritismo da escala 5x2 em reuniăo, mas aponta ressalvas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the presidency of Brazil, met with party legislators to align communication strategy in his defense in the Vorcaro case and demanded data showing popular support for ending the 6x1 work schedule, citing favorability toward the alternative 5x2 model.
